title: Templates
subtitle: Reusable snapshots of hooks, settings, connectors, and policies for workspace sessions.

groups.emptyDescription: A template is a reusable starting point for new sessions.

sections.hooksHint: Commands run before/after tools and sessions.
sections.settingsHint: Permission mode, effort level, model, and custom instructions.
sections.connectorsHint: Connector IDs to attach when this template is applied.
sections.policiesHint: DLP mode, session duration limits, allowed tools, and I/O recording.
sections.secretsHint: Vault secrets that sessions from this template receive as environment variables.

settings.secretEnvHint: VARIABLE=env/secret, comma-separated. Sessions from this template read each vault secret from its variable; only someone who manages the tenant secrets can launch them.

policies.requireTruncateProtection: Require truncation protection for read-only sessions
policies.truncateProtectionHint: Read-only sessions from this template will not start on older kernels that cannot enforce it.
policies.peersSameTemplate: Sessions from this template can message each other

actions.confirmArchiveHint: Archived templates are hidden from the catalog but can be restored.
actions.confirmApplyHint: This will overwrite current session settings with the template values.
